name: Newsroom AI Assistant – Editorial Task Manager & Prompts
author: koskar22

sections.description:
Newsroom AI Assistant is the ultimate workflow optimization tool built specifically for news portals, publishers, and Editors-in-Chief. Developed and tested on active, high-traffic news websites, it brings order to your editorial team and superpowers to your journalists.

If you are running a news site, managing multiple authors, and trying to stay on top of daily trends, this plugin is your new best friend.

🎯 The Hero Feature: Editorial Task Manager

Stop relying on external apps or messy group chats. Manage your newsroom directly from your WordPress dashboard!
* Create Upcoming Events: Schedule coverage for elections, sports finals, or breaking news.
* Direct Author Assignment: Assign specific topics to individual journalists.
* Chief Editor Notes: Pass crucial instructions directly to the writer (e.g., “Get a quote from the Mayor”, “Use archive photos”).
* Smart “Lead Days” Alerts: Set a countdown so the assigned journalist gets a sticky reminder badge on their editor screen exactly when they need to start writing.

🚀 Powerful Free Tools for Journalists:

Equip your writers with tools that save time and boost SEO, right from their post editor sidebar:
* Smart Internal Linking (SEO Optimized): Scan your database with one click to find highly relevant articles based on Post Tags and Smart Keyword extraction. Inserts beautiful “Read Also” links complete with SEO-friendly HTML title attributes.
* Live European Google Trends: What’s breaking right now? View real-time, chronological Google Trends without leaving WordPress. Switch instantly between Greece, Cyprus, UK, USA, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Turkey via AJAX!
* AI Prompts Generator: Engineered prompts ready to be copied into ChatGPT or Gemini. Generate click-worthy Discover titles, rewrite texts with H2/H3 tags, output JSON-LD FAQ Schema, and extract LSI keywords & Meta Descriptions.
* Bilingual UI: Fully supports English and Greek interfaces automatically based on your settings.

👑 Coming Soon: PRO Version (AI Automation)

We are developing the ultimate upgrade: direct API connections (OpenAI/Gemini) for 1-click AI writing directly inside your Gutenberg or Classic Editor.

Support & Contact: Need help or want to request a feature? Contact the developer at koskar22@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin panel and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to the new AI Assistant menu in your dashboard to set your language, preferred region, and start adding Editorial Tasks.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • New: Live European Google Trends! Switch between GR, CY, UK, US, DE, FR, IT, ES, TR directly from your editor sidebar via AJAX.
  • New: Chief Editor Notes. You can now add specific instructions or notes when assigning an editorial task to an author.
  • Enhancement: Upgraded the Smart Internal Linking algorithm. It now prioritizes Post Tags and isolates primary keywords for highly accurate, contextual article recommendations.
  • Enhancement: The Smart Internal Linking modal now stays open, allowing you to insert multiple links seamlessly.
  • SEO: Internal links now automatically include the “title” HTML attribute for better crawling.

1.0.6

  • Update: Trademark compliance renaming to Newsroom AI Assistant.

1.0.5

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
